Is there a way to seal the coin holder?

My daughter has a talent for opening them to play with the inside.

I have also discovered that the print can come off due to rubbing.

Does anyone have any experience of how to protect the area properly?

I glued the four sides together with Tombow Mono Liquid Glue (it sticks well, but is elastic). Works great, just takes a few days to really dry through inside the capsules.

I don’t have the problem with friction with my square coin capsules, as there are suitable foam inserts for magnets from 10 mm. Nothing moves on the inside. But I also stick the RFID tags on top of the magnet and insert, so there is no contact with the print on top?

How old is your daughter?
Please remember that swallowing the magnets can be - !!! LIFE-THREATENING !!! - The strong attraction of the magnets can easily perforate the stomach and intestines!
If she is still small enough, you should secure the capsules all around with the aforementioned glue. Or buy capsules without a grip edge directly, they are also available if I have seen this correctly.
